en: The image is a collage-style postcard featuring several photographs of an ornate classical building with grand columns, intricate wrought ironwork, a majestic staircase, and landscaped gardens. The text 'BUCURESTI Ateneul Român' appears prominently in the center, indicating the subject of the postcard. The building is shown from various angles, both exterior and interior, with a focus on its architectural details and surrounding plaza.
